## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- AdvancedMLStatisticsEngine — MCMC
- 1. MH recovers known normal mean (mu=5) from 100 samples within CI
- 2. Acceptance rate between 15-50% for well-tuned proposal
- 3. Burn-in removal improves posterior estimate
- 4. Gibbs for normal: posterior mean between prior and MLE
- 5. Gibbs for linear regression: coefficients close to OLS
